jobs.title: Hartgrove Hospital is hiring: Security Officer - Flex/PRN in Chicago
jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES
JOB SUMMARY:
* Assures safe and secure environment.
* Guards, patrols, or monitors premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules.
* Patrols premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.
* Answers alarms and investigate disturbances.
* Monitors and authorizes entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintains security of premises.
* Writes reports of daily activities and irregularities, such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences.
* Calls police or fire departments in cases of emergency, such as fire or presence of unauthorized persons.
* Circulates among visitors, patrons, and employees to preserve order and protect property.
* Warns persons of rule infractions or violations, and apprehends or evicts violators from premises, using force when necessary.
* Operates detecting devices to screen individuals and prevents passage of prohibited articles into restricted areas.
- Performs duties while maintaining good service excellence and service recovery skills at all times.
Flex position - no benefits.
For information about the benefits we offer, please visit UHS Benefits Service Center.
QUALIFICATIONS
JOB SPECIFICATIONS:To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each primary duty satisfactorily.
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Education:High School Diploma.
Some College or Higher Education preferred.
Experience:Minimum 1 year experience in security, psychiatric or acute care hospital experience a plus.
Licensure/Certification:PERC card preferred, CPI a plus
Knowledge:Ability to communicate effectively.
Ability to interact effectively and politely with hospital staff, visitors, doctors, etc.
Supervision Received:Director of Security
- Working Conditions:Work hazards associated with potential misconduct in surrounding areas of the Hospital.
Exposure to agitated employees or guests who may exhibit violent/aggressive behavior.
General hospital environment.
Physical Requirements:Ability to communicate verbally, telephonically and in writing.
Physical agility to make Hospital perimeter rounds.
The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the primary functions.
Job Classification:Non-Exempt
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee.

The Security Officer has the responsibility of promoting a safe and secure environment for patients, visitors and staff at either the Chicago campus or the Hinsdale campus.
This is accomplished by patrolling the facility and campus, assuring that the building is secure, responding to emergency situations, taking charge during security incidents, reporting procedures & investigations, responding to special requests as well as performing other duties as assigned.
Reports to: Supervisor of Security and Director of Ancillary Services.
Supervises: None
PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1.
Supports the Mission and Vision of RML Specialty Hospital by demonstrating RML's Core Values of Service, Teamwork, Accountability, Integrity, Respect and Stewardship (STAIRS) in all actions.
Promotes a positive patient/customer experience by exemplifying the principles of the Language of Caring in all interactions with patients, families and co-workers.
2.
- Performs security related activities as assigned to ensure a safe environment inside the hospital building and outside on the hospital campus.
3.
Responds to emergency situations or security threats in a professional manner, following established procedures.
4.
Participates in investigations of security incidents.
5.
Patrols the facility and campus at designated intervals to maintain order and prevent crime.
6.
Reports and documents any conditions that might constitute a security or safety hazard.
Documentation is accurate, complete, and timely.
7.
Assures that offices and departments are secure when vacant.
8.
Reports unsafe conditions as well as policy infractions, takes appropriate actions to resolve issues.
9.
Monitors video management system and takes appropriate actions to respond to any potential threats or unsafe incidents.
10.
Monitors door access control system and hospital lock-out system for breaches.
Ensures systems are in good working order at all times.
11.
Escorts employees and visitors throughout the campus and parking lots as required and requested.
12.
Requests support of area law enforcement agencies when required.
Cooperates fully with area law enforcement when present.
13.
- Provides a visible presence within facility.
14.
Monitors parking lot to ensure compliance with designated parking policies.
15.
Safely and courteously operates hospital vehicles, if needed.
16.
Relieves receptionist at front desk as assigned.
Relief duties include visitor registration, transferring of calls, and annunciation of codes as needed.
17.
- Maintains professional appearance which includes strict adherence to department uniform guidelines, including the issued vest, duty belt, and other equipment required to perform their job appropriately.
18.
Assists Office Services, Plant Operations, and EVS staff, if needed, which includes, but is not limited to, trash disposal and snow removal.
19.
Attends internal meetings and in-services and participates in mandatory reviews of policies and procedures.
20.
Supports the Mission and Vision of RML Specialty Hospital by demonstrating RML's Core Values of Service, Teamwork, Accountability, Integrity, Respect and Stewardship (STAIRS) in all actions.
Promotes a positive patient/customer experience by exemplifying the principles of the Language of Caring in all interactions with patients, families and coworkers.
21.
- Performs other duties as assigned, and as properly trained.
JOB REQUIREMENTS & CHARACTERISTICS
MINIMUMPREFERREDSkills & Abilities
* Ability to lift and carry 80 pounds
* Ability to walk, stand and climb stairs during most of shift.
* Physical ability to effectively address stressful situations, including combative patients, visitors, and employees
* Ability to respond quickly to emergencies, disasters, and other situations requiring physical assistance and a security presence.
* Good interpersonal, communication (written and verbal), teamwork, customer service, and problem solving skills.
Able to work effectively with coworkers.
Knowledge & Experience
* High school graduate or equivalent.
* Previous security experience.
* Computer skills
* Formal training in crisis intervention within 12 months of hire.
* One to two years experience in security in a health care environment.
* Experienced in using video management systems and access control systems.
* Defensive weapons training.
* Police officer training.
* Formal training in crisis intervention.
License/
Certification
* Valid Illinois Driver’s License
* PERC Card
- Working Conditions
* Potential for bodily harm from contact with combative patients, visitors, and staff.
* Potential exposure to hazardous, infectious, or biological materials.
* Exposure to inclement weather.

jobs.title: Lead Public Safety Officer, Swedish Hospital, Nights
jobs.description:
Hourly Pay Range:

$19.89 - $28.84 - The hourly pay rate offered is determined by a candidate's expertise and years of experience, among other factors.

Position Highlights:

  • Position: Lead Public Safety Officer
  • Location: Swedish Hospital
  • Full Time- 40hrs
  • Hours: Nights - 12am – 8:30am
  • Days: Sunday - Thursday

What you will do:

  • Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of patients served. This includes knowledge of the physical and psychological needs of patients served and the ability to respond appropriately to those needs.
  • In the absence of the Shift Supervisor coordinates the work of assigned department staff and determines daily work post assignments.
  • Assist the Shift Supervisor to trains and orient newly hired Security Officers on his/her shift.
  • Monitors Security Officers in performance of their duties and provides on-going direction of activities during the shift. Determines when an incident requires written report, which report form to use and submits to Supervisor, Public Safety. Prepare other written reports as directed.
  • Assist Shift Supervisor to coordinate interviews for investigations with employees and law enforcement agencies.
  • Briefs oncoming Lead Officer regarding any reports and pertinent information.
  • Performs duties of Public Safety Officer


What you will need:

Required Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum of two years’ experience in a customer-focused service-based organization

Preferred Education and/or Experience:

  • Fundamental understanding of computers, loss prevention and fire/security technology
  • A basic level of microcomputer software (i.e. word processing, spreadsheets, etc.)

Required License and/or Certification:

  • Valid Illinois Firearm Owner’s Identification Card is required within 90 days of start date in position
  • Current CPR certification issued either by American Heart Association or Red Cross within 90 days of start date in position
  • A valid driver’s license is required. If the incumbent uses their personal vehicle, the incumbent must maintain automobile liability coverage as required by law and evidence of such coverage may be requested.
  • CPI (Crisis Prevention Intervention) certification within six months of hire

Preferred License and/or Certification:

  • Attainment of certification by the International Association for Healthcare Security and Safety (IAHSS) for their Basic Healthcare Security Officer training course within twelve months of start date in position.
  • Supervisor Healthcare Security Officer Certification

Benefits:

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, holiday and more based on an employee’s job (For eligible positions)
  • Incentive pay for select positions
  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

jobs.title: Security Officer/Driver at La Rabida Children's Hospital Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
Security Officer/Driver job at La Rabida Children's Hospital. Chicago, IL.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital provides specialized, family-centered health care to children with medically complex conditions, disabilities, and chronic illness. Through expertise, compassion, and advocacy we help children and their families reach their fullest potential, regardless of their ability to pay.

Our not-for-profit hospital, licensed for 49 beds, helps transition children from neonatal or pediatric intensive care to home, by providing medical, rehabilitative and developmental care, and by training families to continue treatments and manage the necessary equipment in the home. La Rabida also provides extensive rehabilitation for those recovering from wounds or burns and treatment for exacerbations of chronic conditions.

The hospital’s enhanced pediatric patient-centered medical home provides primary care to children with complex medical conditions and their siblings. Children with medical homes elsewhere come to La Rabida for specialty services. La Rabida offers a wide range of specialty services provided to children with sickle cell disease, diabetes, and many others.

Children are supported in their emotional and developmental growth, particularly in cases where such growth has been interrupted by accident or disease.

Finally, La Rabida provides forensic and treatment services for children exposed to abuse and neglect, comprehensive assessments for youth in care, early intervention for children between 0 and 3 years of age. Care coordination services for medically complex children are also provided for those who are covered by a health plan and receive care from providers in Cook County

Job Description

The Security Officer/Driver patrols and maintains surveillance of the Hospital, both internally and externally, to ensure the physical safety of our employees and the patients we serve. The Security Officer/Driver additionally services patients, visitors, and staff through verbal interaction and vehicular transportation. The percentage of time spent in each capacity varies according to days and shifts worked, as well as shuttle and transportation needs.

Security Officer (35 - 85%)

  • Patrols internal and external building: hallways, secure and open doors, patrol parking areas
Driver (35 - 85%)
  • Operates shuttle service to and from the University of Chicago (Hourly shuttles between 7:30am - 5:30pm, weekdays only and excluding holidays). Also provides US Postal pick-up (weekdays only and excluding holidays)
  • Provides special transportation services: patient transports to off-site healthcare facilities, donation pick-up, vehicle maintenance, and various trips as requested
Information Desk Operations (10%)
  • Greets and directs visitors
  • Issue visitor's passes
  • Communication command station for Security and Transportation Drivers
  • Triage Emergency Room patients
  • Monitors life safety systems
  • Answers Incoming Calls
  • Internal Paging
  • Maintains presence as primary attendant console lunch/break
Camera and door surveillance equipment (5%)
  • View Camera monitor and change tape
  • Inspection Door printouts

Qualifications

  • High School diploma/GED Required
  • Customer Service background. Prefer at least two years experience as a Security Officer in healthcare environment
  • 20-hour basic Security Training Program Certification (Certification waived for current/previous Security/Law Enforcement Officers)
  • Valid State Driver's License - No major driving violations in past year
  • Must maintain valid driver's license while employed in this position
  • Knowledge of basic security operation

Additional Information

La Rabida Children’s Hospital is very proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer La Rabida is a place unlike any other.

We understand the needs of families with children dealing with the most serious or complicated of conditions. With teams of the best healthcare providers in Chicago, we give continuous, comprehensive care, education, and support, helping families face their unique obstacles head-on.

La Rabida Children’s Hospital is very proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: 10 HOSP Ann & Robert H. Lurie Childrens Hospital of Chicago is hiring: Security Officer Sergeant in Chicago
jobs.company: 10 HOSP Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago
jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES
* Conduct training for new cadets and provide ongoing in-service training for Security Services staff.
* Provide leadership to lower ranking Security Officers through counseling, mentorship, and ongoing training resources.
* Perform supervisory duties when a Supervisor is absent.
* Schedule and direct work assignments for lower ranking Security Officers.
* Enforce Medical Center policies, guidelines, and procedures, serving as the source of authority.
* Perform on‑foot patrols of Medical Center campuses as directed by the Director of Security or designate.
* Report safety and fire hazards observed on routine patrols and inspections; identify violations of the Joint Commission, OSHA, NFPA, and local Fire Code.
* Maintain constant communications with the Security Control Center.
* Assist clinical staff with psychiatric patient restraint, monitor and mitigate combative patients, escort patients during clinical transport, and observe patients under medical or psychiatric restrictions.
* Perform emergency responses, including distress calls, panic alarms, fire and disaster response, and support on-site emergencies such as bomb threats, patient abduction, weapon incidents, and hazardous materials.
* Physically intervene to remove unauthorized persons from hospital property, intervene with disruptive adults, confront individuals suspected of criminal acts, substance use, or disorderly conduct.
* Operate locks or unlock specified entrances/exits and perform access control duties at assigned posts.
* Ensure only authorized personnel are admitted; confront unauthorized persons for questions, routing, or detainment as appropriate.
* Dispatch Security Control room operations using Computer‑Aided‑Dispatch systems, monitor CCTV, radio transmissions, alarm consoles, and customer phone calls.
* Utilize incident report software to complete reports, maintain records, and assist the department with data collection.
* Apart from the above duties, appear in court on behalf of the Medical Center to enforce prosecution of individuals for assault or criminal trespass.
* Direct traffic on campus property and control parking, enforce parking guidelines for visitors, contractors, and employees.
* Serve as a resource of information for patients, parents, visitors, and employees, escorting them as needed.
* Secure lost and found items and maintain logs of received items.
* Enhance personal professional growth and maintain currency in the security field through voluntary participation in educational programs and departmental training sessions.
* Operate the hospital shuttle vehicle when required, ensuring safe compliance with all traffic laws.
* Consistently demonstrate customer service values and goals, adhering to service principles with a focus on innovation, excellence, and teamwork to serve patients, families, co‑workers, and others.
QUALIFICATIONS
* High school diploma or equivalent (required).
* Minimum of three years of security experience, preferably in a hospital setting.
* Valid Illinois Driver’s License.
* International Association for Hospital Security and Safety (IAHSS) supervisory training certification (required).
* Good verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with strong English reading, writing, and comprehension.
* Computer literate with working knowledge of Windows‑based software applications and typing ability.
* Excellent customer service skills.
Compensation: Pay Range $21.00 – $32.55 per hour.
The range reflects minimum and maximum targets for the position and is regularly reviewed to align with market conditions.
BENEFITS
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Employer‑paid group term life and disability insurance.
* Employer contribution toward Health Savings Account.
* Flexible Spending Accounts.
* Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* 403(b) retirement plan with a 5% employer match.
* Various voluntary benefits, including supplemental life, AD&D, and disability coverage, critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity coverage.
* Tuition assistance.
* Student loan servicing and support.
* Adoption benefits.
* Backup childcare and eldercare.
* Employee assistance program and other specialized behavioral health services for employees and family members.
* Discount on services at Lurie Children’s facilities.
* Discount purchasing program.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Lurie Children’s and its affiliates are equal employment opportunity employers.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, order of protection status, protected genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
